correctness.rationale: An oriented tree incidence matrix B spans H and has full determinant det(B^T B)=n. Omitting edge e leaves two tree blocks with incidence Gram determinants s_e and n-s_e; the two parallel facets account for surface=2 sum sqrt{s_e(n-s_e)}. Each term >=sqrt(n-1) with equality only for leaf edges, giving star. Moving the smallest branch A to a leaf of second smallest B strictly increases each cut product on the path because a(n-2x-a)>0 from n>=1+a+b+c and a<=b<=c; no other cuts change, forcing path unique max. Independent complete Prüfer tree n=3..6 (1,440 labeled) reproduced exact integer Gram minors and numerical bounds. Riemann sum yields pi/8 sqrt(n).
